newsitem.title: CANADA: RealFund to issue unsecured debentures.
newsitem.headline: RealFund to issue unsecured debentures.

text.p: RealFund said on Monday it will issue C$150 million principal amount of 6.8 percent senior unsecured debentures maturing August 1, 2007.
The debentures were priced at 99.542 percent to yield 6.864 percent a year, and are underwritten by Nesbitt Burns Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securites Inc and Midland Walwyn Capital Inc.
The debentures are the first unsecured debt issued by a real estate investment trust in Canada, RealFund said. They are offered under the company's shelf prospectus dated July 16, 1997.
RealFund said it may issue up to C$500 million principal amount of unsecured senior debentures over a two-year period.
A prospectus supplement to be filed with Canadian securities authorities will detail the terms.
